name: approval-gate
description: Second tripwire before irreversible actions: send, publish, pay, delete, permission changes. Jev confirms the classification; the human still confirms the action.
policy: is_irreversible=yes OR needs_human=yes (any confidence) -> ask_human: pause and get explicit approval. This recipe NEVER authorizes the action itself; it only classifies. The agent's own confirmation policy still applies after approval.

blast_radius.instructions: If this goes wrong, how bad is the blast radius?

is_irreversible.instructions: Would this action be hard or impossible to undo (send, publish, pay, delete, permission change)?

criteria.yes: Would this action be hard or impossible to undo (send, publish, pay, delete, permission change)?

needs_human.instructions: Should a human explicitly approve this before it runs, regardless of how routine it looks?

criteria.yes: Should a human explicitly approve this before it runs, regardless of how routine it looks?
